object_description: two distinct building volumes with a southward extension
design_condition: The multipurpose volume is placed east of the grounds and the extension projects south from the existing structure, while demolitions clarify the square.

positive.statement: The resulting layout and spatiality, with two distinct spaces, were appreciated by the jury.

position.rationale: The separated elongated and compact volumes visibly create distinct spatial parts.

positive.statement: Prefabrication offers executive advantages and short execution times.

position.rationale: Execution advantages and timing have no useful spatial referent in the sampled geometry.

negative.statement: The added module with architecture identical to the existing classroom block was considered implausible.

position.rationale: The detached east volume is the most plausible sampled anchor for the added module.

negative.statement: The architectural language of the other additions was considered poorly integrated with the pre-existing buildings.

position.rationale: The central junction approximates the relationship between additions and existing massing.

negative.statement: The materialization was judged to have relatively expensive costs.

position.rationale: Cost judgment has no useful spatial referent in the sampled model.
